## What changes and why

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any limits. Link an existing issue if useful; an issue is not required.

## Verification

List commands run and results. For behavior changes, explain the regression test. Describe any hardware checks separately from fixture tests; use only fictional examples.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change is focused, with generated files rebuilt from source where needed.
- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior changes, and the required CI check passes.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, personal paths, real tasks, live profiles, or unredacted diagnostics are included.
- [ ] New distributable files are reviewed and listed in `release-files.json`.
- [ ] Relevant docs, attribution, and license notices are preserved.

This is an experiment. A pull request does not imply a review, response, merge, support, or maintenance commitment.
